## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` passes (and `--features unaudited-crypto` if crypto is touched)
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets` is clean
- [ ] Behavioral changes have tests
- [ ] Docs/comments updated where relevant
- [ ] Wording stays within [docs/SECURITY_CLAIMS.md](../docs/SECURITY_CLAIMS.md)
      and [docs/POSITIONING.md](../docs/POSITIONING.md) — no new or stronger
      security claims, actor-neutral language
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private material added
